title: Acidic Greek Rice Avgolemono Soup
description: A tangy, citrusy Greek rice soup with lemongrass and coconut cream, perfect for a post-workout boost.
instructions: Rinse 1 cup jasmine rice until the water runs clear.
In a pot, bring 2 cups vegetable broth to a boil and add the rice, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until the rice is cooked.
In a bowl, whisk 1 egg with 1 tablespoon lemon juice and a pinch of salt until frothy.
Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a saucepan, add 1 tablespoon chopped lemongrass and 1 teaspoon takrai, and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 1 cup coconut cream to the saucepan, stir, and let it simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Remove the saucepan from heat and slowly pour the warm coconut mixture into the heated egg mixture, whisking constantly to prevent curdling.
Return the egg mixture to the pot with the rice, stir gently, and let it simmer 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onion and serve hot.
